comments.title: Submit NSF certification sheets for refrigeration units
comments.text: The equipment schedule does not include manufacturer specification sheets for the reach-in refrigeration units (Items 12 and 13). Submit spec sheets demonstrating NSF certification or equivalent.

comments.title: Relocate mop sink outside food and utensil storage
comments.text: The mop sink is shown inside the dry storage room. Relocate the mop sink so that it is not located within a food or utensil storage area, per CalCode 114281.

comments.title: Show floor sinks and verify indirect-drain air gaps
comments.text: Floor sinks are not indicated for the indirect waste connections at the prep sink and the ice machine. Show floor sink locations, and confirm a minimum 1-inch air gap for all indirect drains.

comments.title: Detail required coved base at kitchen floor-wall junction
comments.text: The finish schedule lists sealed concrete for the kitchen floor but does not specify an integral coved base at the floor-wall juncture. Provide a detail showing a minimum 3/8-inch radius cove base, per CalCode 114268.

comments.title: Add hand sink serving the rear prep area
comments.text: Hand wash sink coverage is insufficient for the back prep area. Based on the layout, staff at the rear prep table would need to pass through a doorway to reach the nearest hand sink. Add a hand wash sink serving the rear prep area.
